'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Alex O'Shea LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck '''Hippies & Rednecks'''. Handwritten. Line 30–31 Escape Pad → Escape Pod (V). Line 53 '''Rebel Gunrunner (V)''' as written. Line 59 '''Tatooine (Ep1)''' as written (linked Tatooine). Two Slight Weapons Malfunction (L40–R41).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing|Communing (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
